proposed_rules.decision: Map to the global nav/header fragment, not page content; exclude from the page's block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical content and position across every packet analyzed indicates shared site chrome, not authored page content.

proposed_rules.decision: Map to the global footer fragment; exclude from page-specific block inventory.

proposed_rules.trigger: Within a repeating 'steps' block, one or more sibling cards render as an empty [bg:color] box with zero children/text while an adjacent sibling card of the same set has full heading+body text.
proposed_rules.decision: Still emit ONE steps block (N rows) rather than dropping the blank rows; flag the missing step text for Phase 2 targeted DOM extraction instead of concluding the steps are content-free.
proposed_rules.rationale: The steps block elsewhere on the same site (C56–C58) always carries full text per row; two blank 100px boxes here almost certainly reflect content clipped by the minWidth capture, not genuinely empty steps.
